description: This file implements the MediaPlayerManager class, which manages media player clients, including attaching/detaching clients, control acquisition, and client creation. It interacts with GStreamer objects and client backends, maintaining a global map of clients and their reference counts.

classes.name: MediaPlayerManager
classes.description: Manages media player clients, handles their lifecycle, control, and creation, using mutexes for thread safety and a map for client tracking.

classes.name: MediaPlayerClientInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a media player client, including the client object, controller, and reference count.

methods.name: attachMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Attaches a media player client to a GstObject parent, creating a new client if necessary or switching clients if a different parent is provided.

methods.name: getMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the current media player client.

methods.name: hasControl
methods.description: Checks if the manager currently has control over the media player client.

methods.name: releaseMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Releases the current media player client, decreasing reference count and cleaning up if needed.

methods.name: acquireControl
methods.description: Attempts to acquire control of a media player client if no controller exists.

methods.name: createMediaPlayerClient
methods.description: Creates and registers a new media player client associated with a GstObject parent, or reuses an existing one.
